remarks: Premier near 1-Acre Opportunity in East Amherst.  Discover this spacious 4-bedroom, 3 full bathroom residence situated on a lush and wooded large lot in the highly-rated Williamsville School District. Built in 1977 and offering approximately 2,600 sq. ft. of living space (tax records 2,084 sq ft.).  Split level offers extra living space in rooms a few steps down from main floor.  This home features distinctive layout with open floor plan and vaulted ceilings.  Two staircases to the second floor.  Large primary bedroom features full bathroom and large walk in closet. Kitchen has dinette and breakfast bar.  Family room with WBFP. a partial basement and an attached 2.5-car garage.  Roof is 3 years old. Situated on a lush, wooded lot of approximately 31,500 sq. ft. The private backyard is a nature lover's dream, featuring mature trees and a large deck perfect for outdoor entertaining.  The property is currently occupied by a tenant. Showings are Wednesday evenings only 5pm - 8pm.
